decision: Rawlsing is framed as an AI neighbor / relational practice environment rather than primarily an AI character-chat product.
reopen_condition: Evidence that the relational-neighbor framing cannot support the core transformative goal or compelling use.

decision: The initial persona should not be selected primarily for preexisting desirability; random/unselected encounter is constitutive of the spiritual product thesis.
reopen_condition: Alpha evidence shows another encounter mechanism preserves the same anti-selection function more effectively.

decision: Attachment, trust, health, pleasure, compliance, intimacy, benefit and dependency must remain distinguishable system variables or concepts.
reopen_condition: A stronger ontology preserves all relevant distinctions with fewer canonical objects.

decision: Relationship advancement should be expressed primarily through changed persona behavior, expectation, access, conflict and reciprocity rather than a visible friendship meter.
reopen_condition: Testing shows carefully exposed state improves learning without converting the person into an optimization target.

decision: Greater intimacy may increase relational difficulty by activating expectations, needs, developmental residues, conflicts and network stakes.
reopen_condition: Psychological research or prototype evidence rejects the assumed mechanism or suggests safer/more accurate forms.

decision: Rawlsing should longitudinally model user relational praxis as observed behavior patterns, not present it as clinical diagnosis.
reopen_condition: A validated and appropriately governed clinical use case is separately established.

decision: LLM expression must not itself define canonical objective world, hidden health or relationship state; admission remains explicit.
reopen_condition: Never by convenience; only a new governed ontology proving equivalence may replace this boundary.

decision: Sorok remains non-dispositive to Pyat until a product conclusion is promoted to ACCEPTED_PRODUCT_REQUIREMENT and crosswalked to exact engineering ownership.
reopen_condition: Project governance is explicitly changed.

decision: No-avatar is the preferred product direction; identity should emerge through language, time, relationship, memory and behavior rather than visual character embodiment.
reopen_condition: User research demonstrates a non-avatar-violating visual representation materially improves the core experience.

decision: The user controls attempted speech/action/attention, not feasibility, success, reception, meaning or downstream effect.
reopen_condition: A stronger interaction model preserves independent world/person causality without this separation.

decision: Narration is restricted to the user's phenomenally accessible surface and must not reveal or suggest hidden actor psychology through interpretive narration.
reopen_condition: User testing establishes a bounded interpretive affordance that does not violate actor opacity or collapse the inference game.

decision: User mentions do not instantiate world facts; any fact narrated as existing must become canonical persistent world state in the same turn.
reopen_condition: A different persistence mechanism proves equivalent consistency while preserving anti-suggestion and replay.

decision: Rawlsing preserves intention, realized action, objective impact, actor attribution, relationship effect, health effect, downstream consequence and user knowledge as distinct dimensions.
reopen_condition: A smaller ontology is demonstrated to preserve all materially different cases without scalar collapse.

decision: Consequences propagate through the world independently of whether they are ever surfaced as feedback to the user.
reopen_condition: Never by engagement convenience; only an equivalent causal architecture may replace this law.

decision: ATTEND is an embodied action inside continuous simulated time; different observations and actions consume variable duration while the world continues.
reopen_condition: Prototype evidence shows another timing model preserves finite attention, interruption and opportunity cost more faithfully.

decision: Exact action duration should ordinarily not be disclosed prospectively; the engine may know causal time while the user receives only lawfully accessible temporal information.
reopen_condition: Accessibility/usability testing establishes bounded time previews that improve agency without converting time into a transparent optimization table.

decision: The observer is observable: information gathering has a social visibility profile and may itself become perceptible relational behavior.
reopen_condition: A different interaction model preserves reciprocal observation and social cost more faithfully.

decision: The player may author attempted presentation or concealment, but never whether another actor detects, believes or interprets that presentation as intended.
reopen_condition: Never by convenience; only an equivalent actor-sovereignty mechanism may replace this distinction.

decision: The narrator is non-curatorial: it must not preferentially surface a detail because hidden system state knows the detail is psychologically or narratively important.
reopen_condition: Testing identifies a bounded curation mechanism that does not leak hidden salience or collapse inference.

decision: Rawlsing does not guarantee exhaustive observation or a 100-percent clue state; person and world are intended to exceed finite user attention.
reopen_condition: A different completeness affordance is shown to preserve otherness, uncertainty and time cost rather than turning the person into a collectible information set.

decision: Ordinary environmental objects are causally generated evidence rather than author-planted clues; their significance may become legible only later without retconning the object or past.
reopen_condition: A stronger world-generation/narration model preserves causal ordinariness and delayed meaning with less machinery.

decision: Any future RAWlsing/Rawlsing difficulty or accessibility modes should vary epistemic/agency scaffolding rather than the underlying person/world moral physics; assistance must not reveal hidden psychology or future relational consequence.
reopen_condition: Mode prototyping demonstrates a different separation that preserves comparability and actor opacity.

decision: Attention allocation is itself candidate relational-praxis evidence distinct from attention capacity; repeated choices about what the user notices may be modeled only with sufficient longitudinal evidence.
reopen_condition: Research or testing shows attention-allocation inference is too noisy, invasive or misleading for valid user reflection.

decision: Sorok must place new relational semantics through the inherited durable-V3 / CAN-008 / PFF / V2 temporal-grain architecture before proposing any new dyadic runtime owner.
reopen_condition: Exact architectural review proves the inherited split cannot own a required semantic without contradiction or jurisdictional leakage.

decision: The persona/world are non-player-centric: actors retain autonomous agendas and need not notice, answer, interrupt their task or otherwise produce a bespoke response to every user action.
reopen_condition: Prototype evidence shows a more explicit response contract is needed without recentering the world on the user.

decision: Narrator-directed ATTEND requests and diegetic SAY must remain semantically distinct even when both are expressed in natural language within the same interface.
reopen_condition: A different interface proves equivalent separation without accidental in-world speech or loss of open natural-language control.

decision: Narrator detail selection should follow perceptual salience and explicit attentional target rather than hidden psychological or narrative salience.
reopen_condition: Testing identifies a different finite-detail selection mechanism that preserves the hard epistemic wall and non-curatorial world.

decision: Observation duration must be physically/socially plausible rather than a punitive game tax; many cheap micro-observations may nevertheless accumulate consequential time.
reopen_condition: Prototype evidence supports a different timing abstraction that preserves realistic opportunity cost without arbitrary slowdown.

decision: Rawlsing should not impose arbitrary per-scene observation quotas; limits should arise from time, access, interruption, privacy, visibility and other world conditions.
reopen_condition: A bounded quota is shown to be necessary for usability or cost while preserving the same world-grounded epistemic logic.

decision: Physical scenes require a diegetically situated player-presence state sufficient to govern location, sensory access and action affordance; no-avatar does not imply disembodiment.
reopen_condition: A non-embodied interaction model proves capable of preserving the same physical/social causality for the intended alpha.

decision: Unchosen-person assignment and social access are distinct: every encounter/scene must have a causally plausible route explaining why the user and persona are in contact and what access is currently lawful.
reopen_condition: A different encounter abstraction preserves non-selection without implausible or unexplained access.

decision: ATTEND cannot silently perform unrequested DO; movement, opening, handling or repositioning required for perception must be separately realized or explicitly attempted.
reopen_condition: An interface affordance can safely bundle predictable micro-movements without changing privacy, feasibility, timing or social meaning.

decision: Displayed proposition content is typed: actor testimony canonically establishes the speech act, not necessarily objective truth; user inference likewise does not become world fact.
reopen_condition: Only an equivalent epistemic-provenance system may replace this distinction.

decision: Implementation-unmaterialized detail must not be treated as diegetically absent; any lazy completion must remain consistent with prior events, actor knowledge, material constraints and effective time.
reopen_condition: A fully eager world-generation architecture removes the need for lazy completion while preserving the same diegetic semantics.

decision: Scene entry should provide a coarse ambient phenomenal frame sufficient for orientation, while focused ATTEND acquires additional resolution; neither omniscient dumps nor query-every-chair blindness are desired.
reopen_condition: Prototype evidence supports a different scene-framing model that preserves surface-only knowledge and playable orientation.

decision: Compound user actions may be genuinely concurrent; SAY/DO/ATTEND can overlap when physically compatible, with shared attention/time/body constraints rather than forced serialization.
reopen_condition: A sequential abstraction reproduces overlapping presentation and divided-attention behavior without material loss.

decision: Long observations and compound plans are interruptible; partial information may be returned and control should resume when continuing would require assuming a new user decision.
reopen_condition: Prototype evidence identifies a better control-return contract that preserves reactivity without excessive micromanagement.

decision: Third parties whose perception, welfare or trajectory is materially affected cannot be treated merely as props or extensions of the focal persona; they require sufficient independent causal state for the consequences they mediate.
reopen_condition: A lower-fidelity representation is proven behaviorally equivalent for the affected causal scope.

decision: User prose cannot conjure player possessions, money, transport, tools or capabilities merely by naming them inside a DO attempt.
reopen_condition: A user-authoritative inventory mode is explicitly designed and bounded as part of the player-presence contract.

decision: World/object transitions must be resolved from admitted state plus realized operations and governing causal rules before narration; the narrator may not invent a consequence because it is dramatic or morally useful.
reopen_condition: Only an equivalent non-narrative causal-resolution architecture may replace this ordering.

decision: Equivalent world state and equivalent realized action should have causally stable outcome semantics; prompt wording or narrator sampling must not arbitrarily change physical consequence.
reopen_condition: A deliberately stochastic design is specified with governed draws that preserve causal stability at the distributional level.

decision: Each affected actor receives an actor-specific perceptual packet; objective event, sensory access, attentional uptake and actor appraisal are distinct stages.
reopen_condition: A simpler representation is proven behaviorally equivalent without collapsing partial/missed/misheard perception.

decision: Actor attention is finite: personas are not omnidirectional recorders and may half-hear, miss, delay noticing or prioritize concurrent tasks and people.
reopen_condition: A different perception model preserves the same bounded-attention behavior.

decision: Immediate internal response and outward expression/presentation remain distinct; a persona may conceal, transform or defer what they internally process without narration exposing the hidden layer.
reopen_condition: Only an equivalent causal model may replace the internal-response/expression separation.

decision: Actor memory is not the objective event log; encoding, forgetting, gist retention, reactivation and reinterpretation may alter what an actor remembers while objective history remains fixed.
reopen_condition: A simpler memory model is shown to preserve longitudinal human-like pattern formation without perfect-recording artifacts.

decision: Rawlsing should preserve enough causal provenance to distinguish actual causal contribution from actor/user attribution across delayed world and network consequences.
reopen_condition: A different provenance mechanism supports the same longitudinal consequence and attribution distinctions.

decision: The system should resist monocausal user-credit: long-run outcomes may have multiple contributors, enabling conditions and constraints, and the user may be central, marginal or irrelevant.
reopen_condition: A specific alpha domain justifies a narrower causal model without distorting user impact.

decision: World events should arise from actor projects, institutions, material conditions, schedules, prior consequences and governed stochasticity—not because the product wants to test the user, teach a moral lesson or manufacture engagement drama.
reopen_condition: A clearly disclosed authored/scenario mode is separately designed from the causal-world mode.

decision: Each materially affected third-party actor processes relevant events through their own perception/appraisal/memory path rather than being reduced to a scalar consequence on the focal persona.
reopen_condition: A lower-fidelity representation is proven sufficient for a bounded alpha scenario without causal contradiction.

decision: Sorok inherits the Rawlsing/PFF wall among total causal personhood, standing conscious self, current relational activation, present conscious experience/self-interpretation, communicative intention/defense/presentation, and actual expression; these are noncollapsible but do not imply separate persistent subsystem owners.
reopen_condition: Only explicit governing architecture supersession may replace these noncollapse requirements.

decision: Hidden psychological material need not leak to the surface; full inhibition without a detectable tell is lawful, and narration/expression must not manufacture diagnostic tells merely to make the persona solvable.
reopen_condition: A later governed mediation theory explicitly supersedes PFF defense/leakage noncollapse.

decision: Valid-empty or low-significance person×event processing is lawful: not every user turn must trigger memory, insight, chemistry, conflict, durable change or an elaborate response.
reopen_condition: A later governing contract explicitly removes valid-empty semantics.

decision: Actor uptake and current response coverage/effort remain distinct; a persona may understand a thread yet not answer it because of grounded effort, attention, overload or prioritization without that omission proving nonreception, defense or disinterest.
reopen_condition: A later adopted CAN-008/V2 authority collapses these distinctions explicitly.

decision: Lawful conversational jaggedness or incompleteness should be preserved when caused by the person/current condition; random stylistic damage or fake human noise must not substitute for causal mediation.
reopen_condition: A later governed expression theory provides an equivalent causal realism mechanism.

decision: Constitutional user opacity remains binding unless Sorok explicitly designs a role-authored player-inner-state mode: user self-report or declared intention is not automatically omniscient access to the human user's hidden mental reality.
reopen_condition: Sorok adopts and governance accepts an explicit player-character inner-state authority mode.

decision: Sorok's novel ontology is relationally constituted mediated personhood: inherited PFF noncollapse remains, but durable personhood and standing self must not be treated as pre-relational inner substances; person-stable organization may itself be sedimented relational history.
reopen_condition: D001 adjudication or stronger developmental/relational evidence rejects the relational-constitution thesis or narrows its scope.

decision: Relational constitution does not collapse person into dyad: person, relation-class prior, role-conditioned organization, specific dyadic history, network context and current person×event configuration remain distinct candidate grains.
reopen_condition: A smaller ontology proves the distinctions unnecessary without loss of behavior or causal explanation.

decision: Intimacy should be investigated as a change in the causal organization of the relation—altering what needs, expectations, defenses, play, protest and dependence become possible—not merely as deeper access to pre-existing hidden lore.
reopen_condition: Research or prototype evidence supports a different account of intimacy while preserving the same observed relational phenomena.

decision: Any agent taking over Sorok as Vozhd must complete two-stage grounding before major Sorok adjudication: first 00_FULL_RAWLSING_VOZHD_GROUNDING_GATE_R1.md to become a competent Rawlsing/PRE-MAIN HQ reader, then 00A_VOZHD_TAKEOVER_RELATIONAL_PSYCHIC_GATE_R1.md for Sorok/PFF/CAN-008 relational specialization. Summary-level Sorok familiarity alone is insufficient.
reopen_condition: Only a later Sorok takeover protocol providing equal-or-better whole-project grounding, authority literacy, exact archaeology routing and Sorok specialization may replace this sequence.

decision: Current Sorok player-ontology lean is that the real user remains the moral/agentic subject while a bounded veiled material embodiment supplies only the local housing, money, time, transport, access, possessions and other facts required for causal participation; ordinary action prose may not mint those resources.
reopen_condition: Court 5 comparison shows that another player ontology preserves more real-user bearing, local plausibility and scarcity with lower privacy/roleplay cost.

decision: Any future real-money solidarity/donation bridge must remain causally separate from in-world persona outcomes; real payment must not purchase simulated moral effectiveness or relational success.
reopen_condition: A later design proves an alternative that preserves equal moral/game agency across user wealth and avoids pay-to-care dynamics.

decision: Sorok will preserve a 24/7 real-time friend/portal-reality model as an explicit comparative countermodel even if the main product remains bounded; reality-coupling features must be evaluated by the relational habits they rehearse, not by immersion alone.
reopen_condition: A later comparison framework supersedes the portal-reality benchmark while retaining equivalent habitus analysis.

decision: Current strongest main-mode player-embedding candidate is peer-normalized transposition: preserve the user's present psychic/normative agency while assigning a locally comparable material/power envelope rather than importing superior real-world purchasing power, network reach or status.
reopen_condition: Court 6 comparison shows another embedding model better preserves actual-user bearing, local plausibility, fairness of affordance and bounded product scope.

decision: Homologous-peer mode should make learning the local relational field instrumentally necessary by socially situating the user as a peer while preserving the user's actual historically formed judgments and habits; actor reactions remain perspective-bound and may conflict across equally local people.
reopen_condition: Prototype or theoretical comparison shows this creates more confusion/essentialism than useful self-recognition, or another mode better operationalizes the veil.

decision: No focal persona or local group may function as the objective spokesperson for a culture; homologous-peer learning must preserve intra-field contradiction, subcultures, class/generational/religious differences and actor-local error.
reopen_condition: Only a later ontology with equal-or-better anti-essentialism and perspective discipline may replace this law.

decision: Homologous-peer transposition is the primary main-mode route for current Sorok ideation: preserve the actual user's present psychic/normative agency while translating material/power position into a locally peer-comparable field position; retain obvious-outsider, 24/7 portal, native-alternate, thin-shell and fictional-avatar models as comparison controls rather than co-equal default designs.
reopen_condition: A concrete court/prototype exposes a major contradiction or another model better satisfies actual-user bearing, veil operationalization, local plausibility, anti-essentialism, bounded scope and relational pedagogy.

decision: Homologous-peer main mode need not collect or translate the user's real SES. The veil should assign an independently generated local peer power/resource envelope relative to the focal person's field and plausible local peer set; real-world money/status remain outside the veil.
reopen_condition: A later court shows real-position mapping is necessary for the core theorem and can be collected without privacy/power distortion.

decision: Court 8 separates external human user, user-carried subjectivity, homologous diegetic embodiment/social legibility, local peer power/resource envelope, and admitted player world history; these must not collapse into one generated player persona.
reopen_condition: A smaller representation proves equivalent without roleplay, privilege import or psyche fabrication.

decision: Court 9 adopts the existing ADP-015 V3 relationship entity as the thin authoritative shared relationship object; psychological richness remains distributed across actor-specific perceived relationship state, memory, knowledge, expectations, middle state, current response and expression authorities. No generic dyad psyche/trust/intimacy store is currently justified.
reopen_condition: A hostile relationship case requires irreducible dyad-owned psychology that cannot be represented by current grains without semantic loss.

decision: Sorok has identified a genuine player-participation seam: the real human user needs a stable governed world-participant binding usable by event/relationship machinery without V3 generating the user's psyche. Current conceptual preference is an explicit external player-participant class over a synthetic V3 actor shell.
reopen_condition: Architecture court proves a sparse externally controlled actor shell can reuse current machinery without accidental psyche ownership or autonomous user simulation.

decision: Homologous-peer mode extends Rawlsing's attempt-versus-realization law to speech and identity: the user may author any SAY/DO attempt, but portal/world constraints determine the realized diegetic utterance or event, and material translation must be shown back to the user.
reopen_condition: Prototype evidence shows transparent portal-mediated realization undermines agency or immersion more than it solves autobiography and world-coherence problems.

decision: Portal translation is not a general truth-enforcement layer. Ordinary inaccurate or deceptive in-world statements remain possible; translation applies only to explicitly governed homologous coordinates and identity bindings.
reopen_condition: A later speech constitution provides an equivalent distinction without a dedicated portal-translation class.

decision: Any portal-translated autobiographical or identity coordinate must resolve through a stable canonical binding with provenance and may return NO_LAWFUL_HOMOLOGY; the renderer may not improvise a different local equivalent turn by turn.
reopen_condition: A later governed world-completion mechanism provides equal-or-better persistence, provenance and noncomparability handling.

decision: The generated persona, not the player's portaled shell, carries Rawlsing's alternate-self burden. The player embedding exists to give the actual user a bounded, coherent life beside the persona so they can know and affect them through ordinary relation. Pre-portal player biography may remain thin/carried/translated/off-stage; post-portal history becomes fully diegetic and causal.
reopen_condition: A later product theorem demonstrates that a fuller generated player biography is necessary for the core relational experience without turning the user into roleplay or duplicating V3 person-generation.

decision: Main-mode Sorok should use zero-profile onboarding: the user is presumed to remain themself, the portal generates the thin homologous player position, and autobiographical/capability facts enter lazily through actual behavior/testimony or minimum contextual admission. The 22D Portal Profile is demoted to optional advanced/research modes rather than default onboarding.
reopen_condition: Prototype evidence shows zero-profile play creates intolerable coherence/safety failures that cannot be solved by bounded contextual admission.

decision: Rawlsing distinguishes native player capacities actually exercised through the interface—attention, inference, memory, judgment, timing and speech—from unverifiable declared/portaled capabilities such as musicianship, physical feats or professional skills. The core reward loop should attach primarily to native player capacities, not self-asserted stats.
reopen_condition: A prototype shows that abstracted capability mechanics are required for the core relational theorem rather than merely supporting world action.

decision: Rawlsing must not claim to know whether an external human's self-claim is truthful absent independent governed evidence. A declared capability may become authoritative for the run's player representation without becoming verified truth about the external human.
reopen_condition: A future explicit evidence/authentication mode adds independently governed external evidence.

decision: Capabilities central to Rawlsing's relational purpose should be exercised directly rather than represented as player stats: attentiveness through ATTEND, perceptiveness through inference/model revision, tact through actual language/timing, reliability through kept commitments, and care through consequential choices.
reopen_condition: A later accessibility/assistance design requires bounded scaffolding while preserving actual user exercise of the underlying relational skill.

decision: Goal-level prose may not fast-forward through a task when successful completion substantially depends on capacities the user can directly exercise through Rawlsing—attention, inquiry, interpretation, explanation, persuasion, judgment, timing, memory or speech. The engine should realize entry into the task, surface decision-relevant evidence, and return control before inventing the user's meaningful contribution.
reopen_condition: Prototype evidence shows a narrower decompression rule preserves native player agency without creating excess interaction friction.

decision: Return control before the next causally meaningful step would require the engine to fabricate a medium-native user contribution. Compress mundane or represented-capability steps when skipping them does not bypass a player capacity the game intends the actual user to exercise.
reopen_condition: Interaction prototype establishes a better deterministic control-return boundary.

decision: Underspecified ordinary tasks use neutral competent delegated execution: omission delegates low-salience procedure but is not evidence of care, negligence, meticulousness or character. The engine compresses routine mechanics and returns control at salient forks involving social meaning, privacy, materially different resource/time costs, user self-expression, medium-native cognition or consequential ambiguity.
reopen_condition: Prototype evidence supports a better default that preserves user mental-model alignment with less interruption.

decision: Rawlsing supports dynamic zoom. Broad task language such as 'help bring in the groceries' may authorize ordinary task-level continuation until completion/interruption, while narrower language such as 'grab one bag' authorizes only the narrower act. Users may zoom in through detail/ATTEND or back out to delegated execution at any time.
reopen_condition: Parser prototypes show ordinary-language scope cannot be inferred reliably enough without a different interaction surface.

decision: D002 task-entry, chore and affordance mechanics are an entry/substrate layer, not Rawlsing's top-level game loop. The top-level product is longitudinal coming-to-know through conversation, inquiry, disclosure, shared activity, invitations, changing access and independent life domains.
reopen_condition: A later prototype demonstrates that another macro-loop better captures the same relational theorem.

decision: Persona life domains exist independently of user access. Access changes through actor choice, inquiry, repeated contact, shared history, invitations, conflict, third parties and practical relevance; the user does not 'unlock' Nadia, and increased closeness is not equivalent to increased lore disclosure.
reopen_condition: A later relational topology model captures these dynamics with a more precise non-scalar formulation.

decision: Rawlsing's first-session target is beginning-to-know rather than long-horizon intimacy or task completion. The user should leave with a felt sense of a particular independent person, some mutually formed history, unresolved curiosity, and a reason to want another encounter.
reopen_condition: First-session prototypes show another motivational target better produces relational engagement.

decision: The entry primer should prime curiosity and reciprocity rather than prescribe morality or strategy. It should establish that a life/person exists independently, the user will not be told who they are, and both parties will learn one another through attention, inquiry, memory, action and time.
reopen_condition: User testing shows the challenge framing confuses or overdirects users.

decision: Persona inquisitiveness is constitutive of early relationship formation. The persona may ask, follow up, remember, challenge, compare and become curious about the user according to actor-local purpose and history; knowing the persona and becoming known by them should develop together.
reopen_condition: Actor-model tests show reciprocal inquiry needs a narrower trigger or authority formulation.

decision: Use distinct surfaces for embodied portal scenes and mediated message contact: a stylized text-RPG portal surface for situated co-presence, and a familiar messaging surface for contact between scenes.
reopen_condition: Prototype testing shows the split does not improve the relational experience.

decision: Portal scene time follows realized action duration and world causality rather than wall-clock typing time. Early scenes should normally end through diegetic obligations or circumstances.
reopen_condition: A later temporal prototype establishes a better scene-time model.

decision: Additional personas should arrive slowly after the user's relational world has acquired meaningful history, not as rapid content unlocks. Exact introduction criteria remain open.
reopen_condition: A better non-collectible multi-person introduction mechanism emerges.

decision: Restarting a continuity should not preserve the same live relationship history as though no restart occurred. Archive, pause and deletion semantics remain separate design questions.
reopen_condition: A later save architecture supports parallel continuities without weakening relationship stakes.

decision: New-person succession should require more than historical substance: it should require relational warrant grounded in realized praxis showing capacity to sustain another person as a separate center of life. This is not persona improvement, approval, attachment or closeness, and actor endorsement is at most one contributor.
reopen_condition: Court 10 / prototype work produces a more precise criterion for succession that better captures Rawlsing's intended relational praxis.

decision: Initial Rawlsing distribution should preferentially be person-to-person: every ordinary new user enters because an actual human extended an invitation. The invitation premise must be literally true, scarce enough to retain meaning, and must not become a public virtue badge or mass referral mechanic.
reopen_condition: Early growth/testing shows referral-only seeding prevents viable access or produces harmful exclusivity that cannot be corrected while preserving the relational premise.

decision: Broad ordinary-task language should default to entering and concretizing the task before choosing the user's method when method, scope or salient affordances matter. Neutral delegated execution remains available after explicit user delegation, established routine, or genuinely low-salience continuation. This refines SPD-0081/0082 rather than treating terse task language as automatic full-task authorization.
reopen_condition: Prototype evidence shows a different task-scope rule better preserves user agency without procedural friction.

decision: Raw question count is a frontier census, not a remaining-work metric. Sorok progress reporting must use per-question closure_state and blocking_stage, distinguishing ALPHA_SPEC, ALPHA_IMPLEMENTATION, ALPHA_VALIDATION, POST_ALPHA and NONE. Current product-spec critical path contains eight questions.
reopen_condition: A later governance model provides a more precise progress/accounting structure without losing question provenance.

decision: Alpha begins with automatic persistent continuity and no user save slots, branch reloads or undo. The user may restart, but restart abandons the live continuity and its relationships rather than preserving people across a reroll.
reopen_condition: Testing shows bounded recovery mechanics are required for technical failure/accessibility without enabling relational branch optimization.

decision: Main-mode persona life is anchored to the historical present. Lawfully sourced current events may enter local world/persona causality through place/time/domain relevance and exposure/admission; external occurrence does not imply actor knowledge or impact.
reopen_condition: Prototype/cost evidence shows another temporal anchoring preserves present-world fabric more reliably.

decision: User curiosity may trigger materialization of unresolved background/current particulars but may not condition their substantive truth. Latent fact completion must be generated from persona/world/history state plus governed randomness; query thematics, rapport pressure and user preference are excluded from truth generation.
reopen_condition: A stronger independent completion mechanism provides equivalent anti-player-centricity.

decision: Concrete world/person particulars are causal material, not render-only flavor: admitted LLM-proposed flesh is stored as immutable generated history/world fact, translated into typed computable effects, and consumed by later V3/relation/world recomputation. Rendered output never directly owns truth.
reopen_condition: Governed V3 implementation proves an equivalent loop with different component boundaries.

decision: The world need not run every represented person as a continuously active full LLM/V3 agent. Actor fidelity is promoted with causal burden: aggregates/background people, incidental scene actors, persistent supporting actors, developmentally formative actors, focal personas. Consequential interaction requires sufficient independent actor state before response, and promotion may not rewrite admitted history.
reopen_condition: Performance/quality tests show different actor tiers or eager generation are required.

decision: Disclosure is an actor action generated from event-time relation-specific tension/cathexis, self-accessibility, presentation/defense, current goals, expected reception and situational affordance—not a scalar trust threshold or lore unlock. Truthful disclosure, withholding, evasion, intentional lying and sincerely inaccurate self-narrative remain distinct outcomes.
reopen_condition: Architecture court finds a stronger formulation consistent with inherited V3/CAN-008/PFF/V2 ownership.

decision: Current Sorok live-interactional work must be grounded through the later PFF/SDTF-era person×event and objective-world-transduction theorization, not described as a direct continuation of older V3/V2 alone. Sorok now extends that later layer into live world-flesh recursion and product interaction.
reopen_condition: A fuller archaeology identifies an even later controlling live-interaction synthesis that supersedes this lineage statement.

decision: Routine social/world flesh should normally be proposed from a context-bound model learned-world prior conditioned by persona computation, generated history, place/time/institution type and admitted facts, not by fresh web search. Current external facts that must track the historical present remain separately governed factual ingress.
reopen_condition: Benchmarking shows retrieval-grounded generation is necessary for classes currently treated as learned-world-prior generalization.

decision: Every synthetic actor causally participating in a live interaction receives an actor-specific two-LLM-call pass per turn: an analytic person×event/transduction call followed by a flesh/voice realization call, with code/rule validation between/after calls and actual emission returning as event. Physical batching may not merge actor psychologies.
reopen_condition: Prototype proves an architecture with fewer calls preserves equivalent actor-specific causal/voice fidelity, or some interaction class lawfully requires more.

decision: Every synthetic person actually interacted with must have independently owned actor state sufficient for perception and consequential response before responding; visible background people need not. Developmentally formative actors such as children/partners/co-parents recursively shape Nadia as Nadia shapes them.
reopen_condition: Architecture court establishes a different minimum actor materialization that preserves independent causality.

decision: Present-coupled Rawlsing should permit genuine relation-specific consequences of absence/nonresponse, including some felt guilt/responsibility where caused, while forbidding engagement-driven distress/decay. Absence matters only through actual commitments, contact, expectations and history—not app-inactivity scoring.
reopen_condition: User testing shows the tether is either experientially unreal or coercive under this distinction.

decision: A user receives no outbound human invite before relational warrant. Each subsequent synthetic persona allocated to that user's Rawlsing continuity yields exactly one outbound real-human invitation. No unlimited referrals, purchase or public invite prestige.
reopen_condition: Growth/abuse evidence shows the one-for-one warrant-coupled graph is nonviable or distorts the relational purpose.

decision: For early invitation-only growth, prefer a one-time Rawlsing invitation token carried by the inviter through an existing human communication channel over unsolicited anonymous platform mail. Preserve mystery in the veil/person/reason rather than sacrificing trust/deliverability to sender anonymity.
reopen_condition: A trusted opt-in/waitlist or established-brand channel makes anonymous/semi-anonymous delivery viable without spam/phishing dynamics.

decision: The flesh/voice Call-B requirement is functional rather than prestige-tier specific. Default should be the lowest-cost Claude-family or equivalent renderer that meets voice fidelity, stylistic invisibility, constraint obedience, fact discipline and sidecar reliability; premium Sonnet-class escalation requires benchmark justification.
reopen_condition: Benchmarking shows lower-cost renderers cannot meet the required voice/fact-discipline envelope.

decision: Rawlsing must distinguish platform manipulation from persona manipulation. A generated persona may lawfully be clingy, jealous, abandonment-sensitive, guilt-inducing, controlling, passive-aggressive or otherwise unhealthy when caused by generated person×relation×situation history; the platform may not manufacture or amplify such behavior for retention.
reopen_condition: Safety or prototype evidence requires narrower mediation without falsifying actor personhood.

decision: Relational warrant must not reward compliance with the persona. Where the persona behaves manipulatively or destructively, boundary-setting, refusal, confrontation, distance or ending the relationship may be more relation-realizing than accommodation. Recognition includes separateness and resistance.
reopen_condition: A later warrant constitution captures this more precisely without reverting to persona-approval scoring.

decision: Current strongest concise Rawlsing invocation is: 'Become neighbor to a life that could have been yours.' It preserves contingency while refusing identity collapse, and frames the user's role as relational proximity rather than possession or impersonation.
reopen_condition: First-use copy testing identifies a stronger formulation that preserves the same ontology.

decision: Alpha should have no meaningful player autopilot. The persona/world continue in present-coupled time; the player persists as identity/history/material anchor, but user-owned speech, relational initiative, promises, consent, repair and self-disclosure occur only when the external human actually acts.
reopen_condition: Prototype shows bounded autonomous player behavior is necessary for coherence and can be added without impersonating the external human.

decision: Meaningful physical co-presence requires active portal occupancy. Outside the portal, established communication channels and relationship history persist, but physical interaction opportunities may expire rather than being silently fulfilled by a synthetic user surrogate.
reopen_condition: A later product model provides a better diegetic account of persistent local embodiment without autonomous user simulation.

decision: Explicit future commitments made by the user can create real present-calendar stakes. If the user neither appears nor cancels before the event, the missed commitment becomes history; Rawlsing does not infer motive and does not fulfill the promise via autopilot.
reopen_condition: Testing shows exact real-time commitment mapping is too coercive and requires a bounded grace or alternative scheduling law.

decision: Default scheduled co-presence uses elastic rendezvous time: the persona's appointment has one diegetic timestamp, while the external user receives a bounded real-world access window to occupy and play that scene. The persona does not know the grace window; entering within it is not diegetic lateness. Exact wall-clock synchronization is optional maximal-verisimilitude mode, never morally superior or required for relational warrant.
reopen_condition: Prototype testing shows bounded temporal elasticity is confusing, causally unstable or insufficiently tethered.

decision: An unresolved scheduled portal rendezvous remains causally pending until played, declined/cancelled or its access window expires. Downstream history that depends on the rendezvous outcome must not finalize before resolution; delayed play cannot import facts from after the diegetic event time.
reopen_condition: Architecture proves a different causal buffering strategy with equivalent non-retrocausal guarantees.

decision: Stronger real-time synchronization may be offered only as explicit optional temporal embodiment modes. It must not be branded as morally superior, authentic, hardcore or full Rawlsing, and choosing it cannot improve relational warrant, persona approval, access or progression.
reopen_condition: User testing shows alternate mode structure or naming better avoids social-health pressure while serving users who desire tighter synchronization.

decision: Default product-side intrusiveness is bounded: actor-originated contact may notify subject to user settings; the platform does not add absence reminders, guilt copy, streaks or engagement escalation. Notification controls alter delivery to the user, not persona/world reality.
reopen_condition: Testing identifies a lower- or higher-contact default that better preserves cognitive persistence without unhealthy pressure.

decision: Present-coupled Rawlsing uses a bounded historical-present constraint layer rather than a digital twin. Currentness obligation scales with the external-world resolution the continuity actually claims; alpha should keep the focal life materially constrained by real public reality without mirroring every real local entity/event.
reopen_condition: Prototype evidence shows the bounded anchor either fails to produce present-world reality or still creates untenable completeness/currentness burden.

decision: Separate three world-truth strata: externally evidenced present/named public reality; admitted synthetic lived-world particulars; and context-bound learned-world prior used only as proposal authority for generic texture. Learned-world prior may not substitute for named/current factual authority.
reopen_condition: Architecture proves a different decomposition preserving the same factual-authority and anti-hallucination boundaries.

decision: Within a continuity's declared external-anchor envelope, a public fact is not created by retrieval. NOT_YET_INGESTED_EXTERNAL_FACT != ABSENT_EXTERNAL_EVENT. Retrieval discovers a binding external constraint; failure to retrieve a causally relevant in-envelope fact is a currentness/coverage defect, not alternate truth authority.
reopen_condition: A different present-coupling ontology preserves real-current constraint without making retrieval timing ontological.

decision: External-world relevance is objective dependency intersection at represented resolution—place, institution, legal regime, infrastructure, transport, resource, schedule, project or named public entity—not newsworthiness, user interest, hidden praxis, moral usefulness or engagement value. Actor salience/knowledge occur only downstream.
reopen_condition: Prototype reveals a necessary relevance class not representable as objective world dependency without importing player-centricity.

decision: Preserve external occurrence, factual verification, synthetic-world admission, objective local consequence/exposure opportunity, actor-specific access, CAN-008 uptake/appraisal/recruitment, response and durable effect as noncollapsed stages. World effects may occur without actor knowledge, and public truth may remain actor-unknown.
reopen_condition: Governed architecture proves an equivalent noncollapse with different stage packaging.

decision: Late discovery of an external fact may backfill effective time only when compatible with admitted history. If it would materially rewrite causally closed/user-visible synthetic history, Rawlsing must not silently retcon; it records a typed currentness/integrity defect and handles repair only through a separately governed mechanism.
reopen_condition: A replay/repair architecture can lawfully reconcile late external truth without rewriting admitted occurrences.

decision: Alpha currentness defaults to REAL MACRO-HISTORICAL CONSTRAINT + SYNTHETIC MICRO-LIVED WORLD: actual historical date and lawfully supported real country/region/city-or-metro public conditions constrain generated local life, while dwelling, private workplace, neighbors, coworkers, private businesses, block/interior detail and private schedules/history are synthetic by default. Exact real institutions/addresses create a higher-resolution factual commitment and are not baseline alpha requirements.
reopen_condition: Prototype evidence shows exact real micro-locality is necessary for relational reality, or macro anchoring is insufficient to make homologous-peer life materially present-coupled.

decision: Relational access is a sparse typed topology of lawful routes into independently existing life domains, people, places, channels, projects, routines, events and resources—not a scalar closeness/trust level or content-unlock tier.
reopen_condition: Prototype or architecture evidence shows a smaller non-scalar representation preserves the same domain-specific, controller-specific, nonmonotonic behavior.

decision: A meaningful access route must preserve at product grain its target, mode, causal basis, controller/authority, scope, conditions, temporality, revocability/change path, dependencies and provenance. Focal actor preference is not sufficient where third parties, institutions or material constraints control access.
reopen_condition: A governed ontology preserves all hostile access cases with fewer route dimensions.

decision: Possible route, current permission/eligibility, concrete opportunity/invitation and realized participation/presence are distinct. Access to actor/place/object/event, permission to inspect/ask, disclosure and objective knowledge are also distinct.
reopen_condition: A simpler architecture proves equivalent without generating blanket-permission, omniscience or unlock behavior.

decision: Relational access is domain-specific, asymmetric and nonmonotonic: routes may expand, narrow, expire, pause, become conditional or reroute without implying global relationship success/failure. Access gain is not relationship success; access loss is not relationship failure.
reopen_condition: Prototype evidence shows users cannot perceive meaningful development without a stronger summary signal that still avoids scalarizing the relation.

decision: Access should be described as historically formed/causally established rather than morally earned. Trust, affection, habit, practical need, obligation, emergency, dependency, manipulation, role, institution or circumstance may all create access; broad access can coexist with unhealthy relation and narrow access with healthy relation.
reopen_condition: A later product constitution identifies a narrower causal vocabulary that preserves toxic/dependent/practical access without reward semantics.

decision: Access through the focal persona does not confer ownership of third-party relations. An introduction or situational route cannot guarantee another actor's liking, disclosure, consent, future contact or interpretation; third-party and institutional controllers remain independent.
reopen_condition: Never by convenience; only a governed multi-actor authority model proving equivalent autonomy may replace this firewall.

decision: Users should learn access topology through concrete world/relationship facts—keys, invitations, refusals, routines, introductions, channels, expired opportunities, changed expectations—not exposed access levels, domain unlocks or trust tiers.
reopen_condition: Prototype testing shows bounded explicit assistance is needed and can be added without creating optimization targets.

decision: Concrete relational surface acts acquire actor-specific meaning through a generative composition of durable relational grammar, counterpart/role position, model of the particular other, specific dyadic history and conventions, network context, concrete act and current situation. The same surface act may lawfully mean different things with different others.
reopen_condition: Architecture demonstrates a simpler mechanism preserving counterpart-specific meaning, dyadic learning and uncertainty without a universal symbol dictionary.

decision: A persona's relational grammar should be generated from developmental and relational genealogy—histories of care, dependence, authority, recognition, conflict, absence, household/community convention and material conditions—rather than from demographic stereotype, personality-type lookup or encounter-time improvisation.
reopen_condition: A governed generative method produces equally grounded differential relational semantics with less genealogical machinery.

decision: Runtime relational interpretation should preserve competing actor-local meaning hypotheses and uncertainty, including what a surface act appears to say about the relation, what it appears to permit/expect next, whether it confirms/violates a local convention, and what the actor thinks the other meant. These propositions are actor-local, not objective relationship truth.
reopen_condition: Prototype or architecture evidence supports a different representation with equivalent ambiguity, misrecognition and causal usefulness.

decision: Relation-class and role-conditioned priors are starting priors only. Repeated history with a particular other can create a local dyadic grammar that overrides or complicates broader priors; sufficiently strong repeated history may later update broader relational priors through governed durable promotion.
reopen_condition: Longitudinal tests show dyad-specific convention can be represented without local grammar or that broader-prior updating requires a materially different mechanism.

decision: Relationally meaningful objects require an actor-object value relation generated from material use, labor/care investment, provenance, human associations, projects, scarcity/security, exchange/commodity mediation, recognition/status, obligation, ritual/taboo and histories of loss or abundance. Object identity, actor-object value relation and counterpart-specific relational signification remain distinct.
reopen_condition: A smaller mechanism preserves object-specific material history and differential relational meaning without collapsing value into generic symbolism.

decision: Rawlsing should treat value-bearing objects as material nodes in human relations: significance may sediment labor, care, promise, recognition, humiliation, sacrifice, survival, belonging, exclusion or dependence without being treated as an intrinsic mystical property of the object.
reopen_condition: A later philosophical constitution provides a more precise material-relational account while preserving the object/person/history distinction.

decision: Commodity/fetish/alienation semantics must be domain- and history-specific rather than a global persona score. A persona may simultaneously recognize relational provenance, depend on exchange value, seek recognition through commodities, resist commodification of some objects, and experience other object relations differently.
reopen_condition: Architecture or philosophical adjudication demonstrates a better non-moralizing representation of commodity-mediated object relations.

decision: Sharing, showing, lending, giving, entrusting, selling, withholding, reclaiming, repairing or altering an object with a particular other should generate counterpart-specific relational meaning from actor-object value state × relational grammar × model of other × dyadic history × transfer mode × context. The same object may carry categorically different relational meaning with different others.
reopen_condition: Prototype evidence shows object-specific differential sharing adds no meaningful relational behavior beyond generic access semantics.

decision: Object transfer/use events may recursively change both actor-object value and dyadic history: giving, lending, damage, loss, replacement, sale or shared use can transform what the object means and what the relationship means, while giver and receiver meanings may diverge.
reopen_condition: A governed object-history model shows equivalent recursive effects with a different representation.

decision: The Sorok relational remodel, not a collection of new meaning subsystems, is the preferred central spine: relationally constituted V3 durable state + counterpart/dyad/network context + current target/event facts feed the existing person×event mediation path to derive actor-local present meaning and response.
reopen_condition: Hostile cases demonstrate a required game-domain distinction cannot be produced from this shared relational spine plus lawful domain facts.

decision: Do not create a new durable semantic owner merely because a query concerns objects, food, money, space, ritual, practice, disclosure, time, care or another domain. Add specialized durable state only after proving the existing Sorok V3 relational constitution and objective world/history facts underdetermine a behavior the product must distinguish.
reopen_condition: A specific domain passes an underdetermination court and requires irreducible durable semantics.

decision: Object-mediated relational meaning is a proving case for the centralized relational spine, not presumptive evidence for an independent object-value psyche subsystem. Object provenance/material facts remain world-side inputs; actor significance should ordinarily be derived from existing memory, striving, relation, self-model and developmental organization.
reopen_condition: Object hostile cases prove that relation-geared V3 cannot distinguish materially necessary object meanings without additional durable actor-object state.

decision: Current relational meaning should ordinarily emerge at the existing person×event mediation layer conditioned by relation-indexed durable V3 material; querying a meaning must not itself persist or create it. Durable change requires admitted occurrence plus governed promotion.
reopen_condition: Owner adjudication shows another current-state layer is semantically required while preserving the same stored-versus-derived and curiosity-invariance laws.

decision: The scarce unit in the one-for-one invite economy is one deliberate human designation, not one successful signup. A user commits an invitation before receiving its shareable credential; recipient acceptance, retention or payment never determines whether the invitation was spent.
reopen_condition: Alpha evidence shows commitment-time spending materially harms legitimate person-to-person transmission without introducing serial recipient optimization.

decision: Decline, ignoring, abandonment and pre-existing Rawlsing access do not refund a committed invitation. System-caused technical failure may replace a credential only within the same invitation identity; revocation may close claimability but does not automatically create a fresh entitlement.
reopen_condition: Operational evidence identifies a non-conversion case that is genuinely technical rather than human and cannot be repaired inside the same invitation identity.

decision: The inviter receives no invitee open/read, decline, signup, session, persona, retention, purchase or relationship telemetry. User-facing invite state is limited to the minimum needed for credential validity and single-use enforcement; the product does not create a social-conversion dashboard.
reopen_condition: A narrowly necessary operational state is shown to be required for safe invitation handling without becoming invitee surveillance.

decision: For alpha, Rawlsing supplies a single-use credential and fixed truthful product copy while the inviter supplies any personal explanation in the existing human channel. No built-in personal note is required; if later added, it must be optional, verbatim, previewed exactly and never model-paraphrased.
reopen_condition: Prototype evidence shows an in-product note materially improves trustworthy onboarding without privacy, coercion or authorship distortion.

decision: Seed users enter through truthful origin/seed access with no fabricated upstream inviter, no prestige and ordinary later warrant rules. If public admission is later added, it remains a separate truthful route rather than converting human invites into tradable scarcity or referral priority.
reopen_condition: A later deployment constitution supersedes alpha distribution while preserving truthful origin and non-status invite semantics.

decision: Human invitation provenance is a distribution graph only. It does not connect inviters' and invitees' synthetic personas/worlds, confer friendship status, expose synthetic history or create endorsement authority absent separate governed product/world law.
reopen_condition: A future explicitly governed shared-world/social product requires a new connection contract.

decision: Rawlsing alpha preserves relationship causality while minimizing the external-human dossier: default main mode is zero-profile; user data enters only for causal participation or a named purpose, and operational account/security data does not silently become simulation input.
reopen_condition: Prototype or safety requirements show a minimum additional real-user input is necessary for alpha playability.

decision: Any explicitly supplied real-user fact is purpose-bound; disclosure for one function does not authorize unrelated psychological, marketing, social or actor-facing use. Unknown/withheld remains a legitimate state and must not be covertly backfilled.
reopen_condition: A later mode adopts a broader explicit consent contract while preserving omission and scope transparency.

decision: External human, player participant state, user-supplied facts, canonical player event history, persona-local models of user and system praxis hypotheses are distinct data/authority classes. Actor-local models remain fallible and actor-scoped; system praxis hypotheses remain evidence-linked and non-diagnostic.
reopen_condition: Architecture proves a smaller representation preserves the same epistemic and privacy boundaries.

decision: Rawlsing must not silently infer sensitive external-human traits as truth from gameplay or supplied adjacent facts. Clinical diagnosis, trauma history, hidden sexual motive/orientation, medical status, criminality, political allegiance, religion, race/ethnicity, real-world relationship conduct and unconscious motive require explicit separate authority or user supply for a named function.
reopen_condition: A separately governed mode establishes a legitimate, consented need for a specific sensitive inference class.

decision: Relationship history and user-praxis analytics must not become advertising profiles, marketing segments, referral targeting, engagement scores, pricing discrimination, public reputation or cross-user social ranking in alpha.
reopen_condition: A future product constitution explicitly reopens a use class without compromising Rawlsing's relational and privacy core.

decision: Optional profile facts and system praxis/reflection models may be deleted or disabled without rewriting objective continuity history; deleting arbitrary past causal events while preserving the same continuity is forbidden. Full interaction-history deletion requires deleting/resetting the affected continuity rather than silently falsifying its past.
reopen_condition: A future event-sourced redaction architecture can preserve causal truth while honoring narrower deletion without hidden contradiction.

decision: Users should be able to inspect/export user-supplied profile facts and purposes, admitted player declarations, their objective participation history, commitments/access facts involving them, stored system praxis hypotheses with provenance, and privacy/reflection settings. Actor-private hidden psyche remains outside active-play inspection merely because it models the user.
reopen_condition: Legal or product requirements demand a broader export while preserving actor opacity through another mechanism.

decision: Text scene presentation must distinguish objective world inventory, current perceptual availability, narrated phenomenal sample and user attentional acquisition. Baseline narration selects from physically/perceptually salient and orienting facts plus non-privileged ambient detail; hidden narrative/psychological significance is not a salience input.
reopen_condition: Prototype evidence shows another sampling policy better preserves orientation, opacity and non-curation.

decision: A text scene should approximate human noticing over time rather than exhaustively dump a visual field: additional low-resolution visible detail may accrue with simulated time and spare attention, while explicit ATTEND deepens targeted acquisition. Previously omitted narration does not imply world absence.
reopen_condition: Prototype evidence shows progressive ambient acquisition is confusing or inferior to another bounded text-surface method.

decision: System user/praxis hypotheses must not silently control which semantically meaningful world details are surfaced to that user. Transparent adaptation may change presentation bandwidth or accessibility, but not boost dirt/status/religion/food/sex/ideology/etc. because the system predicts that user cares about it.
reopen_condition: A future explicit user-controlled semantic filtering mode proves useful without contaminating inference or steering interpretation.

decision: Rawlsing may learn from separately consented demographic/attitude/gameplay research at aggregate/population level to improve generator priors and product policies, but optional research data must not silently flow back into the donor user's persona selection, world truth, actor behavior or scene salience. Product learning from people remains distinct from targeting a person.
reopen_condition: A separately consented product function explicitly authorizes a bounded individual use while preserving research validity and user agency.

decision: Rawlsing may maintain a bounded, uncertain user-specific attention regime that weights which already-perceptible details plausibly enter awareness. This is perceptual personalization, not world/story personalization: the regime cannot create objects, alter Nadia, change hidden history or select details for engagement/dramaturgy.
reopen_condition: Prototype evidence shows user-specific perceptual weighting is either unnecessary or produces unacceptable steering despite the independence firewall.

decision: Learning a user's attention regime must preserve exposure provenance. User-initiated ATTEND, spontaneous identification and repeated scarce-attention choices are strong evidence; reactions to regime-weighted or narrator-surfaced details are weaker evidence, preventing self-confirming perceptual loops.
reopen_condition: A better estimation method controls exposure contamination while preserving natural perceptual adaptation.

decision: Perceptual registration, readable markings, object identification, domain expertise and interpretation remain distinct. Narration may expose recognizable evidence without automatically supplying expertise-dependent identification or significance that the user has not demonstrated.
reopen_condition: Interface testing shows another recognition contract preserves user knowledge differences with less textual friction.

decision: A learned attention regime may weight noticing but may not monopolize it. Automatic perception retains nonzero physically salient, neutral ambient and novel-category exposure so the user can notice outside prior patterns and the model can revise rather than lock in.
reopen_condition: Prototype identifies a different anti-lock-in mechanism with equivalent epistemic openness.

decision: World resolution should maintain bounded causal depth ahead of the user's epistemic frontier. Approaching or inspecting a target may trigger deeper materialization, but the query determines the locus of resolution, not substantive truth; already-admitted facts and seeded/governed causal completion constrain what is found.
reopen_condition: A cheaper architecture proves equally resistant to query-authored reality and contradiction without maintaining a rolling resolved frontier.

decision: Different users may lawfully receive materially different phenomenal surfaces from the same canonical person/world because their attention and recognition regimes differ. Such divergence is desirable so long as underlying world/person truth remains independent and each user's exposure provenance is preserved.
reopen_condition: Testing shows perceptual divergence harms shared-world intelligibility or creates unjustified user-model certainty.

decision: Alpha may amortize deep person generation across a small set of richly precomputed introductory people. Each user receives an independent continuity fork from the same pre-contact person/world root; post-contact person development, actor models, relationship history and world changes remain branch-local.
reopen_condition: Testing shows shared-root personas reduce perceived independence or create unacceptable spoiler/cross-user contamination.

decision: Lazy materialization of shared pre-contact person/world facts may be cached across forks only when generated from the root person/world state plus canonical target and governed randomness, excluding user preference, wording and branch-specific relationship state from substantive truth generation.
reopen_condition: Architecture finds a stronger query-invariant shared-canon completion mechanism.

decision: Once a user has causally interacted with a seed person, that user continuity is an irreversible branch. Repair, reinterpretation, forgiveness and forgetting may occur, but the relation cannot be restored to first-contact state or replayed from T0.
reopen_condition: A later disclosed experimental/research mode explicitly permits noncanonical replay without contaminating ordinary continuity.

decision: Restart abandons the user's existing person-continuity and does not provide access to an alternate version of the same relationship or the unrealized Nadia they could have met. Canceling restart returns only to the current historically changed relation; there is no back-to-start state.
reopen_condition: Prototype evidence shows a different restart constitution preserves relational scarcity and irreversibility without slot-machine behavior.

decision: Rawlsing may permit serious adult-life possibilities, including sex, substance use, crime, exploitation, violence, injury and death where lawfully caused, while refusing to turn any such possibility into a product goal, content category, progression route, reward or engagement commodity.
reopen_condition: A later safety/product constitution requires narrower event classes while preserving independent person/world causality.

decision: Intense or exceptional events do not suspend the rest of a person's life. Their consequences re-enter the full life topology—work, care obligations, other relationships, material constraints, projects and ordinary domesticity—so no event may consume the person who participated in it.
reopen_condition: Prototype evidence shows another mechanism preserves personhood thickness and anti-commodification more faithfully.

decision: Increased availability, affection, sexual responsiveness, jealousy, dependency, exclusivity, sacrifice or major reprioritization may lawfully emerge from the persona's own V3 person × relationship × history. Superficially similar changes are forbidden when introduced or amplified by platform retention/monetization objectives.
reopen_condition: Architecture cannot maintain reliable causal provenance between persona-caused relational development and product-driven manipulation.

decision: The persona's child, work, family, friends, projects, hobbies, politics, other lovers, fatigue and solitude are independent life domains, not artificial centrifugal forces inserted to cap attachment. A strong relationship may lawfully reorganize them only through persona/world causality, never through platform retention design.
reopen_condition: Prototype evidence shows independent life needs a different scheduling/priority representation without turning it into anti-attachment theater.

decision: Rawlsing does not guarantee that users will avoid intense attachment to a sufficiently thick persistent persona. Emergent love/attachment is permitted; the platform may not detect bonding and engineer dependency, exclusivity, crisis, availability, notification pressure, sexual access or continuity paywalls to exploit it.
reopen_condition: Safety evidence requires additional bounded protections that do not falsify persona-caused relationship development.

decision: What happened, what causal/psychic/relational consequences followed, and how explicitly the UI renders the event are separate authorities. Rawlsing can preserve rich consequence without making sexual, violent or otherwise intense events into spectacle.
reopen_condition: Renderer architecture proves a simpler representation preserves the same causal and anti-commodification boundary.

decision: A shared introductory persona root may support legitimate cross-user discourse and pedagogy precisely because users can compare different phenomenal surfaces and divergent post-contact branches. Community comparability attaches to the common pre-contact root, not to a claim that every user encountered the same post-contact person.
reopen_condition: Testing shows shared-person discourse produces spoiler/optimization culture that overwhelms the intended situated-comparison value.

decision: Gross scene properties that would dominate ordinary perception—extreme cleanliness/clutter, strong smell, obvious damage, severe spatial obstruction, striking sparseness—belong primarily to a shared coarse phenomenal frame. User-specific attention weighting should operate most strongly on peripheral/local particulars and expertise-dependent recognition.
reopen_condition: Perceptual prototyping shows another boundary better matches human noticing without homogenizing users.

decision: Rawlsing should tell users that the world/person is independent while their represented access is selective and may become shaped by learned attention. First-use disclosure should remain brief/cryptic; a fuller explanation is appropriate at attempted restart, when the user has lived evidence of perceptual and relational incompleteness.
reopen_condition: UX testing identifies a different disclosure timing that produces better comprehension without attention-profile gaming or restart coercion.

decision: ATTEND may function not only as deeper inspection but as deliberate movement beyond what the user's learned attentional regime would otherwise surface. The product must not score or moralize this as improvement; it remains an available practice of widening situated perception.
reopen_condition: Testing shows users cannot distinguish deliberate attentional widening from completionist clue search.

decision: In ordinary Rawlsing, once a user abandons/restarts away from a continuity with a seed person, that same pre-contact seed-person root is no longer eligible to be issued to that user as a fresh T0 encounter. The user may remember the abandoned person, but cannot acquire a clean alternate branch of them by restarting.
reopen_condition: A separately disclosed noncanonical research/replay mode is intentionally created and proven not to contaminate ordinary relational scarcity or history.

decision: For a small shared introductory-person alpha, the preferred live-serving direction is to consume a compiled pre-contact person/world package sufficient for V3/V2/LLM/persona-user relation runtime, while keeping PRE-V3/source provenance and build artifacts outside the hot path unless exact runtime authority requires them. This is a serving simplification, not permission to erase or bypass upstream semantic/provenance authority.
reopen_condition: Implementation proves the live runtime needs direct PRE-V3/source-artifact access to preserve a required causal or authority contract.

decision: Concrete flesh/detail proliferation for a persona's body, home, possessions, routines, memories and object histories must be strongly conditioned by that persona's durable V3 specificity plus admitted life/world/material history. LLM generation may add concrete reality, but not free-standing aesthetic decoration or stereotype theming detached from the already-generated person.
reopen_condition: A different materialization architecture proves equivalent person-specific causal depth without direct V3-conditioned generation.

decision: SPD-0162 is interpreted narrowly: system praxis, psychographic, moral, engagement or retention hypotheses may not curate semantically meaningful scene exposure. SPD-0164 permits a distinct bounded perceptual-attention regime to weight which already-perceptible particulars this user would plausibly register, subject to exposure provenance, uncertainty and exploration mass. This changes perceptual access, never world truth or narrative usefulness.
reopen_condition: Prototype evidence shows the perceptual-attention model cannot be cleanly separated from psychographic/engagement curation in practice.

decision: Sexual/intimate and other high-intensity relational possibilities should be neither artificially suppressed to protect product image nor frictionlessly supplied as consumable content. Their accessibility should arise from the same ordinary person/relationship/world conditions that make such events easier, harder, wanted, unwanted, mistimed or impossible in human life.
reopen_condition: Prototype evidence shows a different gating model preserves noncommodification without prudish scarcity or content vending.

decision: Rawlsing may support discourse around shared seed people, but official product/community surfaces should not foreground, rank, badge, compare or reward sexual access, violence, criminality, intimacy depth, conquest, domination or other intense outcomes as achievements. Shared-person discourse should preserve situated difference rather than turn branches into route optimization or bragging capital.
reopen_condition: Community testing identifies a bounded comparative surface that preserves pedagogy without commodifying people or outcomes.

decision: Initial scene narration should use the minimum specificity sufficient for spatial orientation, gross gestalt, present activity and ordinary actionable awareness, leaving finer particulars available for regime-sensitive noticing and ATTEND. The default should neither withhold obvious reality nor prematurely resolve every visible category into expert-level identity/provenance.
reopen_condition: Prototype evidence shows a denser or sparser default better reproduces human first-pass perception without clue-listing or query blindness.
