decision: Post-contact user branches may not train, average, tune or otherwise mutate the shared pre-contact seed-person root. Branch-local relationship/person development remains isolated. The only cross-branch accretion permitted into the shared root is query-invariant completion of facts that were already pre-contact and are generated independently of any user's branch history, preferences or outcomes.
reopen_condition: A future explicitly versioned population-learning process proves it can improve seed generation without retroactively changing an existing seed-person identity or contaminating cross-user comparability.

decision: A shared introductory persona is identified by an immutable/versioned pre-contact root. Material changes to that root's person/world package create a new seed-person version rather than silently altering the persona for later users. Cross-user claims of having encountered 'the same Nadia' are valid only within the same root/version, plus acknowledged query-invariant pre-contact backfill compatible with that version.
reopen_condition: Architecture proves a different identity scheme preserves historical comparability, reproducibility and shared-person discourse across product updates.

decision: Cross-user discourse about a shared seed person can give the external human true, false or branch-specific meta-knowledge that their own continuity did not acquire. Rawlsing must not silently convert such knowledge into branch-local perception, actor testimony or world provenance. The user may act using what they know, but any in-world claim retains its actual source class rather than being rewritten as something this branch lawfully observed.
reopen_condition: A future shared-world/multiplayer mode creates a genuine diegetic route by which users can transmit knowledge between continuities.

decision: Sharing the same pre-contact seed-person root does not make post-contact user branches mutually visible. Rawlsing may support voluntary human discourse about experiences, but the platform may not expose another user's branch-specific events, persona models, intimacy, harms, disclosures or outcomes merely because both users encountered the same seed person.
reopen_condition: A separately consented community/research feature establishes explicit branch-sharing permissions without collapsing continuity privacy.

decision: Rawlsing's marketing, storefront, onboarding and acquisition copy must not foreground sexual access, violence, drugs, crime, domination, 'anything goes' freedom or other intense human possibilities as product features merely because they are lawfully possible in-world. Positioning should center encounter, personhood, situated relation and independent life rather than selling exceptional events as consumable attractions.
reopen_condition: Product research finds a truthful way to communicate world openness without converting exceptional human possibilities into acquisition commodities.

decision: Each user continuity binds an exact seed-person root/version and causal-closure snapshot at fork time. A later-resolved pre-contact fact may not be injected backward as an antecedent cause into an already-running branch merely because it is propositionally compatible. If the fact would materially have changed prior actor/world processing, the existing branch preserves its causally closed history; the new fact applies only through a lawful nonretroactive path or a new seed version.
reopen_condition: Architecture proves a causally equivalent latent-variable mechanism that permits later resolution without retrospective branch mutation.

decision: Shared-seed comparisons and research must bind not only seed-person version but the relevant root-resolution/closure state. Query-invariant lazy facts may be generated at different wall-clock times, but user order must not create semantically different starting persons while all are labeled the same version; any material closure change requires reproducible derivation or explicit version/closure lineage.
reopen_condition: A deterministic derivation scheme proves root-resolution timing is observationally and causally irrelevant across all compared branches.

decision: Research using identical/shared seed-person roots must treat prior external exposure to that persona—community discussion, spoilers, strategy guides, another user's branch report, prior play on another account/context, or other meta-knowledge—as an experimental/provenance variable rather than assuming all participants are epistemically naive. Analyses claiming clean same-root comparison must segment, control, exclude or explicitly model such exposure.
reopen_condition: A research design proves external shared-person exposure cannot materially affect the measured attention, interpretation or relational behavior outcomes.

decision: Rawlsing should not expose a canonical hidden-truth dossier, wiki, completion percentage, master biography or root-fact encyclopedia for a live seed person. User-facing recaps may summarize that user's own lawfully acquired branch history/knowledge, but hidden root person/world truth remains non-completion content so community discourse does not collapse the person into a solvable object.
reopen_condition: A later archival/research surface proves it can expose bounded canonical material without undermining actor opacity, unknowability, branch provenance or completion resistance.

decision: Rawlsing should resist commodification through independent person/world causality, ordinary consequences and relational thickness rather than by scolding, shaming or mechanically punishing users merely for lawful desire, sexual interest, attachment, curiosity, intensity-seeking or other ordinary motives. Actors may judge or react according to their own person/history; the platform itself should not become a moralizing narrator or purity system.
reopen_condition: A specific safety boundary requires explicit platform intervention that cannot be implemented without violating this nonmoralizing default.

decision: Abandoned-person nonreentry applies across the recognized seed-person identity lineage, not merely one exact root hash/version. A product update or materially revised Nadia root must not be used to give the same user a fresh first meeting with 'Nadia' after they abandoned an earlier Nadia continuity. Versioning preserves technical/historical identity distinctions without creating a restart loophole.
reopen_condition: A later product ontology defines a genuinely distinct generated person that should not count as the same seed-person lineage despite shared ancestry or naming.

decision: The learned attention regime is a bounded user-level presentation/perception hypothesis, distinct from any persona's model of the user and from any one relationship branch. It may persist across persona continuities so Rawlsing can model recurring attentional habits, but must remain context-tagged, revisable, resettable/deletable under privacy law, and incapable of rewriting prior branch history or becoming canonical personality truth.
reopen_condition: Prototype evidence shows cross-continuity persistence causes unacceptable privacy, steering or stale-model effects that cannot be solved by uncertainty/context/deletion controls.
